Alarms & security consulting

The right protection starts with understanding the risks. We review your operation, find the weak spots and propose a solution that combines technology and people.

What's included

  • Risk analysis

    A review of premises, routines and vulnerabilities, with a written report.

  • Security plan

    Concrete measures in the right order, fitted to your budget.

  • Alarm installation

    Intruder alarms and alarm security fitted to your operation.

  • Training

    Security routines and preparedness for your staff.
